[!GOOS:linux] skip 'the ARM64 native driver leg needs linux'
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'the ARM64 native driver leg uses installed linux/amd64 tools'
[!exec:qemu-aarch64] skip 'qemu-aarch64 is required for the ARM64 native driver leg'
[!symlink] skip 'the emulated driver needs a private GOROOT tool-directory overlay'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOAMD64=
env GOARM64=v8.0
env GOARCH=arm64
go build -o $WORK/logos cmd/go
env GOARM64=

mkdir $WORK/goroot/pkg/tool
symlink $WORK/goroot/src -> $GOROOT/src
symlink $WORK/goroot/lib -> $GOROOT/lib
symlink $WORK/goroot/go.env -> $GOROOT/go.env
symlink $WORK/goroot/VERSION -> $GOROOT/VERSION
symlink $WORK/goroot/pkg/include -> $GOROOT/pkg/include
symlink $WORK/goroot/pkg/tool/linux_arm64 -> $GOROOT/pkg/tool/linux_amd64
symlink $WORK/goroot/pkg/tool/linux_amd64 -> $GOROOT/pkg/tool/linux_amd64
env GOROOT=$WORK/goroot

exec qemu-aarch64 -cpu cortex-a53 $WORK/logos build -o $WORK/native-a53 .
go version -m $WORK/native-a53
stdout 'GOARM64=v8\.0(\s|$)'
exec qemu-aarch64 -cpu cortex-a53 $WORK/native-a53
stdout '^hello$'

exec qemu-aarch64 -cpu max $WORK/logos build -o $WORK/native-max .
go version -m $WORK/native-max
stdout 'GOARM64=v8\.1(\s|$)'
exec qemu-aarch64 -cpu max $WORK/native-max
stdout '^hello$'

env GOARCH=amd64
exec qemu-aarch64 -cpu cortex-a53 $WORK/logos build -o $WORK/cross-a53 .
go version -m $WORK/cross-a53
stdout 'GOAMD64=v1(\s|$)'
exec $WORK/cross-a53
stdout '^hello$'

exec qemu-aarch64 -cpu max $WORK/logos build -o $WORK/cross-max .
go version -m $WORK/cross-max
stdout 'GOAMD64=v1(\s|$)'
exec $WORK/cross-max
stdout '^hello$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/nativearm64qemu

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "native"

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
